notes: Read all 285 source lines before editing; mapped line-by-line in the output header comment (L1-13 imports, L15-26 timeAgo, L28-42 status helpers, L44-54 props, L56-82 hooks/handleToggle, L84-187 header+menu, L189-202 vehicle row, L204-238 stats row, L240-246 auto-disabled warning, L248-270 conflicts, L273-285 ConfirmDialog/close).

Behavior preserved verbatim: state names menuOpen/confirmDelete (L66-67), uiStatus useMemo (L69), conflicts ?? [] (L71), handleToggle auto_disabled re-enable-vs-onToggle branch (L73-82), all four callbacks onToggle/onReEnable/onDelete/onTestRun, and the auto_disabled? false : enabled toggle value (L114).

timeAgo (L17-26) and the status helpers AutomationUIStatus/getUIStatus/statusStyles (L30-42) ported byte-for-byte; formatDateTime (L13 from @/lib/dateFormat) inlined verbatim (GDPRExportPage precedent) so the rendered 'Next' string is byte-identical.

react-i18next useTranslation (L5) -> local web-parity i18n shim returning the inline English fallback; every t('key','English') key/fallback is unchanged. The shim also resolves the object form t('automations.deleteMessage', { name, defaultValue }) (L276) by substituting {{name}} so the delete message is byte-identical.

cn from @/lib/cn (L6) dropped (RN has no className); the GlassPanel conditional classes (isFiring ring/shadow L89, auto-disabled red border L90) and the conflict warning/info classes (L256-258) become conditional StyleSheet entries.

@/components/ui (L7): GlassPanel -> shared native GlassPanel; Badge -> web-parity native Badge (variant success|neutral|danger is exactly its accepted subset, size='sm'); Button (ghost icon-only / menu rows) -> native Pressables; Toggle -> RN core Switch (role=switch, accessible; onValueChange -> onChange(checked), checked -> value, aria-label -> accessibilityLabel); size='sm' is cosmetic and not expressible on Switch.

ConfirmDialog (L7) -> local RN Modal-backed ConfirmDialog implementing the prop subset this call site uses (open/title/message/confirmLabel/cancelLabel/variant/onConfirm/onCancel L273-282); backdrop-tap and hardware-back map to onCancel. The full web dialog's loading spinner / requireTypedConfirmation / silenceKey are not exercised here and belong to the dedicated ConfirmDialog port.

PinButton (L7, L112) -> local native equivalent backed by the already-ported usePinned/useTogglePin hooks, so pin state (pinned.some(item_id===id)) and the pin/unpin mutate({itemId,pin}) behave exactly like web; the web Tooltip wrapper and CSS hover are dropped (no native analog). The shared PinButton gets its own dedicated parity file later.

lucide-react icons (L8-11) have no native SVG analog -> small decorative glyphs in AppText (SecurityAccessPage precedent), each accessibilityElementsHidden because adjacent text carries meaning: Zap=⚡, AlertTriangle=⚠️, MoreVertical=⋮ (kebab, labeled), Play=▶, RotateCcw=↺, Copy=⧉, Download=⬇, Trash2=🗑, Car=🚗, CheckCircle=✅, XCircle=❌, SkipForward=⏭️. The icon-only kebab/switch/pin carry their own accessibilityLabel.

UNAVAILABLE on native (documented): CSS animate-pulse on the firing badge (L100) and transition-all duration-normal (L88) have no RN analog and are dropped; the firing glyph keeps the cyan-300 colour and 'Firing' text so the cue is preserved. The web full-screen fixed inset-0 menu backdrop (L133) becomes an in-panel absolute-fill backdrop covering the card (tap closes the menu; taps fully outside the card do not auto-close); the dropdown is anchored top-right under the kebab via absolute top/right.

Tailwind -> StyleSheet conversions applied (1 unit = 4px): p-4=16, gap-1/2/3=4/8/12, mt-3=12, mt-2=8, mt-0.5=2, px-3=12, py-2/1.5=8/6, rounded-lg/md=8/6, w-44=176, text-base/sm/xs=16/14/12; colours --text-primary/secondary/muted -> colors.text*, red-500/10 -> dangerSurface, red-300/400 -> #fca5a5/#f87171, cyan-300 -> #67e8f9, amber-300 -> #fcd34d, blue-500/10+blue-300 -> rgba(59,130,246,0.12)/#93c5fd, gray-900 -> #111827, neon-cyan/70 -> rgba(53,213,255,0.72).

No DOM-only modules, browser HTML elements, Recharts, Leaflet, or old web UI components imported — only React, react-native primitives (Modal/Pressable/Switch/View/StyleSheet), the shared native AppText/GlassPanel + theme tokens, the web-parity Badge, and the web-parity usePinned/useTogglePin hooks + Automation type.
Gates run from apps/native: npm run typecheck; npm run lint -- --quiet; npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles.
